title: Hub access point
remind: The hub’s own Wi-Fi still uses the first-login password. Set your own so that only you can join it.
help: 8–63 characters: Latin letters, digits, symbols. Applies at once — devices on the hub’s Wi-Fi reconnect.
bad: 8–63 characters, Latin letters, digits and symbols only.
confirmBody: Phones and laptops connected to the hub’s own Wi-Fi drop off and need the new password.
afterRestart: It takes effect after a restart.
needToken: Changing it needs the admin token (Settings → Access).
rejected: The hub refused the password: 8–63 printable characters.
statusNeedsToken: The hub shows whether its own password is set only with the admin token (Settings → Access).
